notes:
1.1.9: your own areas, and a Settings tab

- Settings > Areas > Edit areas: rename, recolour (9 colours), reorder, add (suggestions like
  Master's thesis, Bachelor's thesis, Coursework) and remove areas; removing an area moves its
  tasks and routines to another one. Synced to all devices.
- Top bar shows All plus the areas that fit (at most 3); the rest open from More (+N)
- Hours, week summary, Load view and legends split by every area
- Quick add: @areaname (e.g. @master) picks the area
- Settings has its own tab (bottom bar on phone/tablet, side rail on PC)
- PhD and Personal keep their ids, so existing tasks are unchanged
